caption: A stage floods with yellow light, and the white set and curtains all look yellow at once.

sa.check: A stage has a set and curtains.
The set and curtains look yellow.
The set and curtains are white before the light.
The change is all at once.
The light comes first and the colour changes with it.

pc.expect: The set looks yellow only where the light's light reaches and while it is on.
pc.fail: The set is yellow with the light off; or stays white under the yellow light; or turns a different colour from the light.

pc.expect: The change happens at the same instant as the light and is confined to where its light falls.
pc.fail: The set changes before the light; or long after; or surfaces the light cannot reach change too.

pc.expect: The folds show as darker and lighter yellow, not as colour changes.
pc.fail: Folds are a different colour; or the set is flat yellow with no shading; or the folds vanish.

pc.expect: Nothing moves; only the light changes.
pc.fail: The set moves; or the light moves by itself; or the lit area wanders.
A second light appears; or the set vanishes; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The set's shape and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The set changes shape; or the surroundings rearrange; or the light changes shape.
